title: Ice Maker Not Making Ice
shortDescription: LG refrigerator ice maker fails to produce ice within the expected cycle time.
fullDescription:
The IE error on LG ice makers indicates the ice maker has not detected a successful harvest cycle. The control board monitors ice production and triggers this error after repeated failed attempts.

Common causes include a frozen water supply line, faulty inlet valve, or defective ice maker module. The error typically appears on the refrigerator display and halts ice production until cleared.

fixSteps.title: Check water supply
fixSteps.instruction: Verify the saddle valve behind fridge is fully open and water line is not kinked.

fixSteps.title: Thaw supply line
fixSteps.instruction: If line is frozen, unplug fridge for 2 hours or use a hairdryer on low to thaw.

fixSteps.title: Test inlet valve
fixSteps.instruction: Use a multimeter to check continuity on the water inlet valve solenoid.

whenToCallPro: If inlet valve replacement requires disconnecting the fridge from water supply and you are uncomfortable working with water lines.

faq.a: Yes, unplug the fridge for 5 minutes, then plug back in. If error returns, water line or valve needs attention.

title: Ice Maker Sensor Error
shortDescription: LG ice maker fan or sensor malfunction detected.
fullDescription:
Er IS indicates a fault with the ice maker fan motor or temperature sensor in the ice room. The fan circulates cold air to freeze water in the mold.

When the control board detects abnormal fan RPM or sensor readings, it displays this error and stops ice production to prevent damage.
symptoms: Noisy fan or no fan sound

fixSteps.title: Remove ice bucket
fixSteps.instruction: Pull out ice bucket and check for overflow ice jammed against the fan.

fixSteps.title: Defrost ice compartment
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug fridge for 6-8 hours to melt any frost on the fan.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan motor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove ice maker cover, disconnect fan harness, install new fan.

whenToCallPro: If defrost does not clear the error and you are uncomfortable disassembling the freezer interior.
videoSearchQuery: LG refrigerator Er IS ice maker fan error

faq.q: Is Er IS same as IS?
faq.a: Yes, both refer to ice system fan or sensor issues.
Yes, the fridge and freezer still work; only ice making is disabled.

title: Ice System Auto Mode Off
shortDescription: Ice maker has been automatically disabled due to repeated cycle failures.
fullDescription:
The IS code indicates the ice maker has been placed in automatic shutoff mode after the control board detected multiple failed harvest cycles.

This is a protective measure to prevent flooding or component damage. The user must address the underlying issue and manually re-enable the ice maker.

fixSteps.title: Check ice maker switch
fixSteps.instruction: Locate the on/off switch or button on the ice maker and confirm it is on.

fixSteps.title: Clear ice bin
fixSteps.instruction: Empty ice bin completely, checking for clumped ice blocking the sensor arm.

fixSteps.title: Reset ice maker
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold test button for 3 seconds to initiate a manual cycle.

whenToCallPro: Only if manual reset does not re-enable the ice maker after correcting obvious issues.
videoSearchQuery: LG ice maker IS code reset

faq.q: How to turn ice maker back on?
faq.a: Use the ice maker button on the dispenser panel or the physical switch inside the freezer.

title: Freezer Fan Error
shortDescription: Freezer evaporator fan motor not operating correctly.
fullDescription:
FF indicates the freezer fan is not reaching target RPM, which affects ice maker cooling. Without proper airflow, the ice mold cannot reach freezing temperature.

The main board monitors fan feedback and logs this error when the fan is stalled, obstructed, or electrically faulty.

fixSteps.title: Defrost freezer
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug unit and let it defrost fully, 8-12 hours with doors open.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fan
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear freezer panel to expose evaporator fan and inspect blades.

fixSteps.title: Test motor
fixSteps.instruction: Measure resistance across fan motor leads; replace if open or shorted.

whenToCallPro: If defrost does not resolve and you cannot disassemble the freezer panel safely.
videoSearchQuery: LG refrigerator FF error freezer fan

faq.a: If the freezer is warming, transfer frozen items to another unit during repair.

title: Refrigerator Fan Error
shortDescription: Refrigerator compartment fan issue affecting ice maker performance.
fullDescription:
rF indicates the refrigerator section fan is failing. In LG models where the ice maker is located in the fresh food compartment, this directly impacts ice production.

Look for obstructions, frost buildup around the fan, or motor failure.

fixSteps.title: Defrost fridge
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug for 8 hours to clear any ice around the fan.

fixSteps.title: Access fan
fixSteps.instruction: Remove back wall panel in fridge section to reach fan.

whenToCallPro: If the issue persists after defrosting and fan replacement.

faq.a: Monitor fridge temp; if above 40F for over 4 hours, discard perishables.

title: Communication Error Between Boards
shortDescription: Main and ice maker sub-board cannot communicate.
fullDescription:
CO indicates loss of data communication between the refrigerator main control board and the ice maker sub-board. Often caused by a loose connector or damaged harness.

Without communication, the ice maker cannot receive harvest or fill commands.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug fridge for 10 minutes, then plug back in.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connectors
fixSteps.instruction: Access control boards and firmly reseat all ribbon cables.

whenToCallPro: If reseating connections does not resolve, board replacement may be needed.

faq.a: Communication Open - indicates the main board lost signal from a sub-board.

title: Water Filter Replacement Indicator
shortDescription: Water filter has reached its service life and must be replaced.
fullDescription:
The filter indicator illuminates after 6 months or ~300 gallons of water use. A saturated filter reduces water flow, which can cause slow ice production or hollow cubes.

Replace with a genuine LG filter (LT1000P or similar) for best results.

fixSteps.title: Buy replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Purchase the LT1000P or model-specified filter.

fixSteps.title: Install filter
fixSteps.instruction: Rotate old filter counter-clockwise, remove, insert new filter and turn clockwise.

fixSteps.title: Reset indicator
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold the Filter button for 3 seconds until light turns off.

whenToCallPro: Not typically needed; filter change is a user task.

faq.a: Yes, but certified replacements are recommended to ensure fit and filtration standards.

title: Defrost Sensor Error
shortDescription: Defrost thermistor reading out of range.
fullDescription:
Er 6 indicates the defrost sensor in the freezer/ice maker compartment is reading an open or shorted value. Without valid defrost sensor data, ice mold temperatures cannot be regulated.

Typically requires thermistor replacement.

fixSteps.title: Check connections
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect sensor harness for loose or damaged wires.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new defrost thermistor and reconnect harness.

whenToCallPro: If you are not comfortable working with freezer evaporator disassembly.

faq.a: No - defrost failure can lead to ice buildup and damage the evaporator.

title: Ice Maker Not Initialized
shortDescription: Ice maker did not complete initial test cycle.
fullDescription:
Er IT appears when a newly installed or reset ice maker fails its initial test cycle. The unit expects to see water fill, freeze, and harvest within a defined window.

Often resolved by ensuring water supply is connected and running a manual test cycle.

fixSteps.title: Confirm water line
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure water saddle valve is open and line is connected.

fixSteps.title: Run test cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Press the ice maker test button to manually start a cycle.

whenToCallPro: If initial test fails with water connected, a technician may need to verify the module.
videoSearchQuery: LG ice maker Er IT initial test

faq.a: Yes, it typically clears after the first successful cycle.

title: Condenser Fan Error
shortDescription: Condenser fan not running, affecting overall cooling.
fullDescription:
CF indicates the condenser fan motor at the rear of the fridge is not spinning. This impacts the compressor's ability to expel heat, which can slow or stop ice production.

Check for debris or a seized motor bearing.

fixSteps.title: Clean condenser area
fixSteps.instruction: Vacuum behind fridge and around condenser coils.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan motor
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect harness and install new condenser fan.

whenToCallPro: If cleaning does not resolve and fan is seized.

faq.q: How often should I clean coils?
faq.a: At least twice a year to prevent this error and maintain efficiency.
